verdict.rationale: Open-source availability is a fair question for a research-agent platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers a pip-installable client (edison-client), API-key authentication and hosted agents, with no mention of a public source repository or an open license. An installable package is not evidence that the source is published under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
